invite.title: Invite a colleague
invite.description: The invitation carries the role and the teams, so joining is one step rather than three.
invite.roleHint: You can only hand out a role that stays within what you may do yourself.
invite.localeHint: The letter is written in this language; the person has no account to take one from yet.
invite.sent: The invitation to {{email}} is on its way.
invite.linkHint: This link is shown once. Re-issuing it from the list replaces it and stops the old one working.
invite.copyFailed: Copying failed — select the link and copy it by hand.
invite.noMail: This installation cannot send e-mail, so nothing was posted. Pass the link on yourself.

invitations.title: Open invitations
invitations.description: Everybody who has been invited and has not joined yet. An invitation that has run out stays on this list — it is the one you re-issue or close.
invitations.failed: The open invitations could not be loaded.
invitations.revoked: The invitation is closed and its link no longer works.
invitations.reissued: A new link for {{email}} is ready.

empty.title: Nobody is waiting for an answer
empty.description: Every invitation sent so far has been accepted, closed or has run out and been closed.

resend.title: Re-issue the link
resend.description: A new link will be minted for {{email}}.

consequence.oldLink: The previous link stops working, including one that has already been passed on.
consequence.expiry: The new link works for another seven days.
consequence.once: It is shown once — the server keeps only a digest and cannot produce it again.

resend.failed: The link could not be re-issued.

revoke.title: Close the invitation
revoke.description: The invitation for {{email}} will be deleted.

consequence.link: The link stops working, whoever has it.
consequence.person: The person can no longer join with it, and a new invitation has to be sent.

revoke.failed: The invitation could not be closed.

accept.title: Join the team
accept.description: Choose a password and you are in. The address is the one you were invited on.

empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.description: Invite a colleague and they will appear on this list.
empty.filtered: Nobody matches these filters. Try widening them.

list.failed: The directory could not be loaded.

chart.failed: The org chart could not be loaded.

reactivate.title: Bring this account back
reactivate.description: Deactivating closed the way in. This opens it again — and only that.

dialog.title: Bring the account back
dialog.description: {{email}} will be able to sign in again, from the moment you confirm.

restored.title: What comes back
restored.signIn: Signing in, everywhere — with the password the person already has.

roles.named: Every role the account still holds: {{roles}}. Deactivating never took them away, so they all come back at once.
roles.none: The account holds no role, so it comes back with nothing beyond the ability to sign in.
roles.pending: Reading which roles the account holds…
roles.unavailable: The roles this account holds could not be read. It keeps all of them regardless — check them on the «Roles» tab before you confirm.
roles.hidden: The account keeps every role it held. You may not read which ones, so ask somebody who can if that matters here.

limits.title: What does not come back
limits.description: These were given up when the account was switched off, and are handed out again by a person who decides so today — not by this button.
limits.teams: Team memberships, with whatever they carried.
limits.vaults: Access to shared vaults, which needs a key handed over again.

failed.title: Not brought back — nothing was changed

done.title: The account is on again
done.description: The person can sign in with their existing password. Anything still signed in as them from before stays signed out.

notRestored.title: Still revoked — grant these again if they are needed
notRestored.description: The account came back; what it belonged to did not. Nobody is told about the list below, so whoever needs it back has to be added by hand.

already.title: Already on — this run changed nothing
already.description: The account was active before this run: nothing was written and no trail entry was made. This is what a second tab, or a second administrator, looks like — not a failure.
